The main takeaway from our work is that
cryptocaryol A is more potent than cryptocaryol B, and the 3-O-methyl ether is a key structural element for PDCD4 stabilization.
the 2,3,6-triols are the minimal pharmacophore required to stabilize PDCD4, and the 2,4,6-triyl triol is a less potent PDCD4 activator.
the 1,4-unsaturated 2,6-dioxo-piperazine ring is not required to stabilize PDCD4, as the 1,2,3,4,6-pentahydroxy-piperazine ring of cryptocaryols is sufficient for this activity.
